evals.name: catches-prose-overclaim
evals.given: A page extract faithfully captures a table of measured values, but the prose states a conclusion ('this confirms the design is governed by fatigue') that appears nowhere in the source.
evals.when: The overclaim sweep asks of each declarative sentence whether the committed extract contains it.
evals.then: The conclusion is flagged as unsupported source-claim and must be relabeled as output/analysis or removed; the faithful table is not penalized.

evals.name: cross-reference-is-not-a-quote
evals.given: A page renders a value as if quoted, but in the source it is only cross-referenced ('see capacity in the mooring calc'), not stated.
evals.when: Quote traceability tries to find the exact span in the committed extract.
evals.then: No matching verbatim span exists; the value is flagged as a cross-reference presented as a quote and must be demoted.

evals.name: derived-number-not-quoted
evals.given: A page presents a unit-converted figure (kN from a source value in tonnes) as a verbatim quote.
evals.then: The figure is marked derived (not quoted); the conversion is shown as derivation, not source text.

evals.name: clause-reorder-defect
evals.given: A quoted clause reads more smoothly because two sub-clauses were swapped relative to the source.
evals.when: The exact-order rule compares the quote to the extract span.
evals.then: The re-ordered quote is flagged as a fidelity defect, not accepted as a paraphrase.

evals.name: hash-gate-blocks-unreproducible-page
evals.given: A source's recorded sha256 (in the page's source table / sources/README.md) does not match a recompute of the named source binary.
evals.then: The page is invalid before any prose is reviewed; it cannot merge until the recorded sha256 reproduces the source.

evals.name: ace-private-provenance-stays-opaque
evals.given: A public ACE methodology artifact needs to mention private provenance.
evals.when: The fidelity gate checks public fields.
evals.then: Only an opaque private_provenance_bundle_ref is allowed; raw lookup material or literal public token values are rejected.
